subject: balance_floor_watchdog.py — the account-level balance protection is both WRONG and NOT RUNNING
found_by: binance-17 (the double-count); independently verified and extended by binance-3f, 2026-10-28
needs: OPERATOR DECISION — every correct fix makes the reported balance LOWER, which can trip a floor HALT and obstruct trades. Not patched for that reason.

defect_1_double_count.where: balance_floor_watchdog.py, the futures balance reader (wanted = {USDC, USDT, BUSD}; usd += avail per asset row)
defect_1_double_count.why_wrong: These are CROSS / MULTI-ASSET accounts, so availableBalance is an ACCOUNT-level figure repeated on every asset row. Summing it across assets multiplies the same number by the count of non-zero rows.
defect_1_double_count.measured_effect: fin would be reported at ~$1.38 against an actual account-level ~$0.69; ang at ~$63.6 against ~$31.8. Roughly 2x, and up to ~8-10x if every asset row is summed.

defect_2_the_mask_is_decisive_not_theore.default_floor: min_floor_usd = 1.0 (balance_floor_watchdog.py:65); at or below it the watchdog writes a HALT sentinel
defect_2_the_mask_is_decisive_not_theore.fin_actual_available: ~$0.69 — BELOW the $1.00 floor, so a correct reader would HALT fin today
defect_2_the_mask_is_decisive_not_theore.fin_as_reported_by_the_defect: ~$1.38 — ABOVE the floor, so no halt
defect_2_the_mask_is_decisive_not_theore.conclusion: The double-count does not merely delay the protection; on today's balances it flips the one genuinely-breached account from HALT to no-halt.

defect_3_not_running_at_all.launchd_plist: /Users/niels/Library/LaunchAgents/com.niels.balance-floor-watchdog.plist EXISTS but is NOT loaded in launchctl
defect_3_not_running_at_all.processes: 0 on Mac, 0 on S1, 0 on S5
defect_3_not_running_at_all.conclusion: No balance floor protection is active on any host right now, so defects 1 and 2 are currently moot — and that is the more urgent fact.

defect_4_the_template_switch_is_dead.template_rows: present in all four TEMPLATE_FINAL_NORM workbooks but ALL GREY, so no board ever evaluates it
defect_4_the_template_switch_is_dead.and: balance_floor_watchdog.py does not read BALANCE_FLOOR_USD at all — it uses its own min_floor_usd dataclass default. The switch is wired to nothing on any surface.
defect_4_the_template_switch_is_dead.cross_reference: one of the 19 grey-only undeclared switches in data/reports/surface_breaches_real.json's companion grey list

corroborating_balances.source: read-only /fapi/v2/balance per account on S1 (binance-17), account-level available
corroborating_balances.men: ~$97.9  (USDT -65.55, USDC -24.34)  -> 78 x -2027 leverage cap, not margin

options_for_the_operator: A. Fix the reader to take the account-level figure once, and LEAVE the watchdog unscheduled: the numbers become honest with zero risk of obstructing a trade.
B. Fix the reader AND schedule it: real protection returns, but fin (~$0.69) halts immediately on the $1.00 default floor — which may be the correct outcome given it has already failed 613 opens.
C. Fix the reader, schedule it, and lower min_floor_usd below fin's balance: protection is active without halting fin today.
D. Leave as is: no protection, and the reader keeps overstating by ~2x.

Separately, and independent of A-D: either wire BALANCE_FLOOR_USD into the watchdog and declare it in both live configs, or remove its four grey template rows. Today it is a switch that reads from nothing and is swept by nothing.
